text:
sara_cs: Morning — Stability check for BeaconTech this week. TL;DR: p95 latency up ~220ms (now ~1.2s), 5xx +2.1% WoW mostly 502/503, timeouts +5.4% concentrated on parallel embed jobs and interactive generate. Rate limits small but visible during their morning burst. Posting top failing endpoints, windows, quick repros and proposed mitigations.

tom_sre: please paste top endpoints + any infra signals you've correlated.
sara_cs: top offenders last 7d (with spike windows):
- POST /v1/generate/interactive — p95 ~1.9s, 5xx 0.9%, spike 01:45-02:30 UTC (concurrent nightly syncs)
- POST /api/v1/embeds/parallel — timeouts ~2.7% on parallel batches (>10 concurrent streams), spike 14:00-14:40 UTC
- POST /v2/upload/chunked — intermittent timeouts 0.6% during large file ingestion, spike 02:10-02:40 UTC
- POST /v1/streaming/summarize — rate_limit (429) up to 0.7% during 17:10-17:40 local peak
- POST /internal/queue/ingress — 5xx 0.5% correlated with retry storms from upstream router

julie_prod: note — BeaconTech enabled parallel-embeds by default in their integration last month; that increased concurrent connections per client.
tom_sre: infra notes — short GPU reclaim on dedicated pool at 02:05 UTC, and ingress nodes showing CPU saturation at 14:05 UTC on a few instances. Dash: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/beacon/errors?from=now-7d&to=now Traces sample: https://traces.redwood.ai/beacon/1799990/sample
tom_sre: repro for parallel embed timeout (simulate many concurrent workers):
```
# run many curl loops in parallel to simulate concurrency
for i in {1..20}; do \
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/api/v1/embeds/parallel -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"items":["<long text>"]}' --max-time 10 &\
done; wait
```

sara_cs: we've also observed client libraries retrying immediately which amplifies the ingress queue and causes more 502s. ops-bot fired a threshold alert: BeaconTech 5xx breached (last 1h = 52, threshold = 35).
ops-bot: alert: BeaconTech 5xx threshold breached (last 1h = 52, threshold = 35)
max_pm: high-level — renewal health check in 6 days. Is this a renewal conversation?
sara_cs: short answer: medium. They're vocal about latency in weekly ops. If we reduce p95 and avoid repeated 5xx incidents we should be fine. Proposed remediation plan: short-term (today) and short-med (48-72h) actions below.

Proposed immediate actions (today):
- add an edge circuit-breaker for /api/v1/embeds/parallel to limit concurrent in-flight requests per tenant to 10 (owner: tom_sre)
- enable soft-accept for very large uploads on /v2/upload/chunked (return 202 + background ingestion) to avoid client blocking (owner: julie_prod)
- add jittered retry guidance for BeaconTech SDK and ask them to increase backoff windows (owner: sara_cs)

Short-medium (48-72h):
- roll a canary to route a subset of BeaconTech traffic to a warm pool (pre-warmed instances) during 14:00-15:00 UTC to absorb bursts (owner: tom_sre)
- offer a temporary client-side config: reduce parallel embed workers default to 4 for BeaconTech (owner: julie_prod / DevEx)
- implement a graceful degradation flag for /v1/streaming/summarize so clients can request partial_results=true to trade completeness for latency (owner: julie_prod)

Medium (1 week):
- consider a short dedicated capacity bump during BeaconTech nightly sync window while we measure the effect of edge controls (owner: max_pm)

tom_sre: I'll open the edge-rule PR for the circuit-breaker canary and post the link here. Initial staging sim showed concurrent throttling reduced embed timeouts ~58% in our load tests.
julie_prod: I can add the 202 soft-accept behavior behind a feature flag and update API docs; will coordinate with DevEx for SDK guidance.
sara_cs: I'll prepare a 1-slide summary for the renewal call highlighting our mitigations and timelines.
ops-bot: continue monitoring and page SRE if breaches persist >2x threshold.
Action items recap: 
- tom_sre: edge circuit-breaker canary + PR (due: today EOD)
- julie_prod: implement soft-accept for large uploads + partial_results flag doc (due: 48h)
- sara_cs: customer briefing slide + SDK backoff request (due: before renewal meeting)
- max_pm: evaluate short capacity bump if canary doesn't sufficiently reduce p95 (due: within 7 days)

tom_sre: pinged when PR is up. staging canary looked promising; will move to limited prod canary tonight.
sara_cs: thanks all — I'll share the customer-facing note after the canary is green. :thumbsup:
